summary: Tested M11 CLUBE backend + frontend. Backend: 22/23 pytest tests passed (95.6%). End-to-end win flow (place single_digit bid -> admin declare result 550 -> verify bid won + wallet credited 95 pts + notification created) PASSED. Frontend: user login/register, dashboard, bottom nav, admin login, admin sidebar nav, settings, results, users, payments, markets list all render fine. Found 1 critical backend bug (admin market create returns 500 due to MongoDB ObjectId not JSON serializable) and 1 critical UI bug (Made with Emergent floating badge overlaps and blocks bottom-nav-funds & bottom-nav-support clicks on mobile).

critical.issue: Returns 500 'Internal Server Error'. Root cause: server.py admin_create_market builds doc, calls db.markets.insert_one(doc) which mutates doc by adding MongoDB _id (ObjectId), then `return doc` — FastAPI cannot JSON-serialize ObjectId. Frontend UI also breaks with 'Request failed with status code 500'.

ui_bugs.issue: The floating 'Made with Emergent' badge (id=emergent-badge) overlaps bottom-right area and intercepts pointer events on the right-most bottom-nav tabs (bottom-nav-funds, bottom-nav-support). Playwright click without force=True fails. Real users on small phones may be unable to tap Funds/Support tabs. Solution: increase bottom-nav z-index above the badge, add bottom padding, or reposition the badge.
Add Market 'Save' triggers 500 from API and a 'Request failed with status code 500' toast — but the modal stays open and new market is not created. Caused by backend bug above.

issues: Open/Close time inputs use the browser's native HTML time picker instead of a shadcn time picker; acceptable but inconsistent with rest of UI

action_items: FIX backend server.py admin_create_market: pop '_id' from doc before returning (e.g. `doc.pop('_id', None); return doc`). Apply same defensive pop pattern in any other endpoint that returns a freshly-inserted doc.
FIX MobileLayout: ensure bottom nav stays above (z-index) and is not overlapped by the Emergent badge. Add safe-area padding-bottom for mobile so tabs are tappable above the floating badge.
Optional: Consider seeding cleanup — my pytest left a TEST_MARKET with declared result 550 in the DB. You may want to delete it via Admin UI or a cleanup script.
Optional: Add data-testid='admin-nav-bids' to the All Bids sidebar link (current selector missing).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_create_market returns the dict mutated by motor's insert_one which contains a non-serializable ObjectId — must strip _id (matches the project's own `serialize()` helper which is used elsewhere). High-risk pattern; ensure all admin write endpoints reuse a serializer.
server.py uses bare `except Exception` in _market_open_status — fine but logs would help diagnose IST parse failures.
MarketIn model lacks regex/format validation for open_time/close_time (e.g. 'HH:MM'); a malformed value would fall back to is_market_active=False silently.
server.py auth dependency: admin token can also call /api/auth/me as get_current_user blocks only on status=='blocked'. Currently no impact but role mismatch is not enforced for user-only endpoints.
Frontend 'Made with Emergent' badge overlay must not block primary navigation; this is a recurring UX bug across mobile-first apps.

rca_of_the_issue: Issue 1 (Admin Market 500): db.markets.insert_one(doc) in Motor mutates the supplied dict by injecting ObjectId('_id'). The endpoint then returns the dict directly via FastAPI, which calls jsonable_encoder, which cannot encode ObjectId -> ValueError. Reproduce: POST /api/admin/markets with valid body and admin token -> 500. Fix: doc.pop('_id', None) before return, or use the existing serialize() helper.  Issue 2 (Bottom Nav blocked): Emergent floating badge sits in fixed position bottom-right with higher z-index/event capture than the BottomNav links. On 390x844 viewport the badge covers the rightmost ~80px of the nav bar, so 'Funds' and 'Support' tabs cannot receive clicks. Fix: ensure bottom-nav z-index > badge, or add mb-12 padding to layout so nav sits above the badge.
